title: The source-size check covers every Rust file under src, not only listed families
outcome: The source-size check covers every Rust file under src, not only listed families
acceptance: Files already over the limit when it lands are listed by name as known exceptions, each pointing at its split item, and the check fails if an exception grows or a new one appears
The source-size check fails when any .rs file under src exceeds 2,499 physical lines, so a new or growing file cannot pass unlisted, while keeping per-family runs for host evidence

completion.summary: The source-size check walks every .rs file under src at any depth and fails any file over 2,499 lines that is not a listed known exception. Exceptions live in tests/source_file_size_exceptions.json as {path, max_lines, split_item}, each validated. A listed file fails when it grows past its ceiling, and its ceiling must come down when it shrinks. A stale entry fails the whole-tree run. The list starts empty: 357 files, none over the limit. Links and junctions under src are refused rather than followed. The family tests stay for per-file evidence, share the limit checker, and keep their report budget. Landed as b7384f8.
